plans.text: Get a remote shutter release for the camera.
Get a neutral density filter for photography.
Compare Gitzo and Really Right Stuff tripods when choosing a new tripod.
Consider upgrading from the Nikon D5600 to a full-frame camera body, possibly a Nikon Z6 or Canon EOS R, and assess whether the image-quality improvement is worth the investment.
Go with the Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L camera bag.
Consider getting a wide-angle lens, such as a 14-24mm or 16-35mm, for sweeping landscapes and cityscapes to complement the 70-200mm zoom lens.

superseded_plans.text: Get a sturdy and durable tripod to replace the old Manfrotto BeFree and support the Nikon D5600 and lenses.
Consider getting the Manfrotto MT057CXPRO4 as a sturdy and durable tripod to replace the old Manfrotto BeFree and support the Nikon D5600 and lenses.
Get a bag that protects the camera gear well and can carry the Nikon D5600 and several lenses, including the 50mm prime.
Compare the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW and Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L when choosing a new camera bag to replace the old one.

preferences.text: Prefers the Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L's sleek design and versatility.
Prefers photography bags suited to street and travel photography.
